stories.title: Survey: Companies Cite Phishing as their Top AI-Enabled Fraud Concern
stories.summary: A recent survey from Experian found that 60% of companies report fraud losses that are “somewhat or significantly higher” than in previous years, with a majority of respondents citing AI-generated phishing attacks as their top AI-related fraud concern.

stories.title: Threat Actor Generates 1M Personalized Fraud Emails in 3 Days
stories.summary: Cybercriminals behind malicious email campaigns no longer have to compromise volume for credibility, or vice versa, thanks to AI.

stories.title: California Brown Pelican
stories.summary: California Brown Pelican, in San Mateo County, CA, US The Pacifica Pier shut down at the start of June after a crack in the concrete walkway made access to the pier unsafe. It has since been entirely taken over by pelicans! Tags: wildlife

stories.title: Radio France staff strike over appointment of far-right weekly editor
stories.summary: Staff at public broadcaster Radio France began a two-day strike on Sunday over the appointment of Charles Sapin, deputy editor-in-chief at far-right weekly Valeurs Actuelles. Unions accuse Sapin of promoting far-right ideas ahead of next spring's presidential…

stories.title: France apologises for diplomatic spat with US to lift block on new ambassador to Washington
stories.summary: The French UN mission said it regretted an online post criticising a US vote at the UN General Assembly in a move that should clear the way for the new French ambassador Aurélien Lechevallier to take up his post in Washington.

stories.title: OpenAI will not go public in 2026, says CEO Sam Altman
stories.summary: Citing safety concerns, Altman told 'Fortune' business magazine that 'right now would be an ill-advised moment' for OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT, to become a public company.

stories.title: September 13, 2010: The day Rafael Nadal completed the career Grand Slam
stories.summary: Every day, Tennis Majors takes you back to the biggest moments in tennis history. On September 13, 2010, Rafael Nadal defeated Novak Djokovic in four sets to win his first US Open title

stories.title: Rybakina beats Sabalenka to win US Open for the first time
stories.summary: Elena Rybakina beats the two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka to win her first US Open and her third Grand Slam title overall.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
